name: Hedgemaze
summary:
Hedgemaze is a logic puzzle inspired by nonograms, picross, and deduction puzzles. Use row and column clues to build a single perfect path through flowers, zen gardens, torii gates, and winding rivers.

Each puzzle challenges you to determine exactly which cells become hedge and which become path. Every puzzle has one unique solution and can be solved with logic alone. No guessing required.

Play 2,000+ puzzles across four difficulties. Start with 6×6 Easy grids and work your way up to challenging 12×12 Expert puzzles with rivers, bridges, and new twists to master.

Take on a new Daily Challenge every day. Solve three puzzles that reset at midnight, compete on global leaderboards for the fastest times, and track your streaks and best solves.

Built with a player-first mentality.
